nuggets.text: The Huskies piled up 671 yards against Lafayette last week, a program single-game record.
Kalieb Osborne, a Toledo transfer, threw for two touchdowns and ran for two more in his first start for UConn.
Jason Candle arrived at UConn as the winningest head coach in Toledo football history.
Jason Candle won two Division III national titles as a Mount Union receiver, then three more as an assistant there.
The Huskies returned just one starter this season, offensive lineman Ty Chan, and added 87 new players.
Rentschler Field stands on the site of a former airfield that operated from 1933 to 1999.
Every UConn husky mascot is named Jonathan, after Jonathan Trumbull, Connecticut's first state governor.
Jonathan III, an early Husky mascot, traveled to Antarctica to assist Admiral Richard E. Byrd.
Bill Belichick applied to be UConn's head coach in 1983 and was passed over for an internal candidate.
The Huskies' 49-point win over Lafayette was the third-largest margin of victory in school history.
